description: Triage the review feedback on your PR: which comments actually need you? Gathers bot (CodeRabbit, cubic, Greptile, Copilot) and human review comments, classifies each finding as likely-real, likely-noise, or needs-decision with the reason stated, and drafts a reply for each. Human reviewer comments are never called noise. Drafts only; nothing is posted. Call this after pushing and getting review feedback.

pr_url.description: Full GitHub PR URL, e.g. https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/123

name: review_triage
